name: Dr. Jawad Fadel Abulhasan
description: Dr. Jawad Abulhasan is a distinguished physiotherapist with a Ph.D. from the University of Birmingham and extensive experience in sports medicine and rehabilitation. As the founder and director of Kinesia Physiotherapy Center, he combines advanced clinical expertise with a commitment to patient-centered care.

name: Dr. Khalid Nafa
description: Khalid Nafa is a skilled physiotherapist with experience in rehabilitation, injury recovery, and sports therapy. He specializes in manual therapy, dry needling, and recovery management, providing personalized treatment plans to enhance patient well-being.
university: Jordan University of Science and Technology

name: Dr. Suad AlShammari
description: Suad AlShammari is an experienced physiotherapist specializing in musculoskeletal pain, sports injuries, and women's health. With a background in rehabilitation and neurological disorders, she focuses on enhancing patient mobility and recovery.

name: Dr. Deema Bitar
description: Deema Bitar is a dedicated physiotherapist with expertise in women's health, sports rehabilitation, and musculoskeletal pain. Holding a master's in physiotherapy, she focuses on injury recovery, balance improvement, and postnatal fitness.

name: Dr. Aly H. Alatar
description: Aly H. Alatar is a physiotherapist, researcher, and public speaker specializing in spine health, pain management, and behavioral psychology. With a Ph.D. from the University of Birmingham, he actively contributes to health awareness, education, and research, sharing his expertise through lectures, publications, and community initiatives.

name: Dr. Waed Al-Dabaibeh
description: Waed Al-Dabaibeh is a Senior Physiotherapist specializing in sports injury recovery and performance enhancement. With extensive experience in patient care, she provides tailored treatments to help patients regain mobility and achieve peak performance.

name: Dr. Mahmood Abdulhadi
description: Mahmood Abdulhadi is a passionate and skilled Physiotherapist specializing in sports injuries, rehabilitation, and patient care. He provides tailored treatment plans using advanced techniques to promote recovery and improve physical performance.
degree: Bachelor of Science (BS) in Physical Therapy

name: Dr. Esraa Dashti
description: Esraa Dashti is an experienced Physiotherapist with six years of expertise in various specializations of physical therapy. She is passionate about helping patients achieve optimal recovery through personalized treatment plans.

name: Dr. Mariam AlKandari
description: Mariam AlKandari is a skilled physiotherapist and certified dry needling practitioner with seven years of experience. She specializes in ankle and foot injuries and rehabilitation. Additionally, she is a certified breastfeeding counselor and educator, helping new moms navigate their maternity and breastfeeding journey.
degree: Bachelor of Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation

name: Dr. Moath Aziz Bander
description: Moath Aziz Bander is a dedicated Physiotherapist specializing in sports rehabilitation and training. He has experience in treating patients with various conditions, including orthopedic, cardiovascular, respiratory, and neurological disorders. He is also a certified dry needling practitioner and blood flow restriction trainer.

name: Dr. Aya Emad Othman Hasan
description: Aya Emad Othman Hasan is an experienced physiotherapist with expertise in post-operative rehabilitation, injury assessment, and movement retraining. She has worked in multiple healthcare facilities and has certifications in dry needling, kinesiology taping, and McKenzie therapy for the lumbar spine.

name: Dr. Ahmed Salem Al Banwa
description: Ahmed Salem Al Banwa is a senior physiotherapist and co-founder of Kinesia Physiotherapy Center. He holds a Bachelor's and Doctorate in Physical Therapy, with over 20 years of clinical experience in musculoskeletal conditions, specializing in tendinopathy, sports rehabilitation, sports medicine, performance enhancement, and injury prevention. Additionally, he is an experienced runner who has completed five major marathons and is a certified running coach with a special qualification in running injuries. He has participated in numerous conferences and courses and has organized and presented workshops related to tendinopathy and running injuries.
degree: Bachelor's and Doctorate in Physical Therapy
